description: Make EIA's large self-describing hierarchy useful from the terminal without hidden unit conversions, frequency mismatches, silent truncation, forecasts, or causal claims.

novel_features.name: Latest grid pulse
novel_features.description: Fetch recent balancing-authority measures and show per-type latest values, units, freshness, and transparent trailing means.

novel_features.name: Alignment-safe series comparison
novel_features.description: Compare explicitly selected state series only when route, data column, frequency, periods, and units align.

novel_features.name: Guarded cross-series spread
novel_features.description: Align two facet series by period and refuse subtraction when reported units differ.

novel_features.name: Explainable anomaly scan
novel_features.description: Compute deterministic mean and standard-deviation deviations from exact bounded EIA source rows without forecasting.

novel_features.name: Saved watch evaluation
novel_features.description: Evaluate a bounded JSON rule set once for thresholds, freshness, missing data, and changes while retaining source rows.

novel_features.name: Source revision diff
novel_features.description: Compare a bounded route/facet snapshot with the prior local observation and report changed period-value-unit keys.
